title: ESP32 dev board mounting plate
prompt: I need a carrier plate for my ESP32 dev board so I can screw it into an enclosure. The board has four mounting holes; I measured them at 47 x 23.5 mm centre to centre and they take M2.5 screws, so make those 2.7 mm. Plate 70 x 40 mm, 3 mm thick, with the board pattern centred on it. Also add four M3 clearance holes (3.4 mm) in the corners, 4 mm in from both edges, for screwing the plate down. Printing it in PETG.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
70 x 40 mm plate, 3 mm thick, ±0.1 mm
Four 2.7 mm (M2.5 clearance) holes on the board's 47 x 23.5 mm rectangle
The board pattern is centred: each board hole is 8.25 mm from the long edge and 11.5 mm from the short edge
Four M3 clearance holes (3.2–3.5 mm) on a 62 x 32 mm rectangle
Each M3 hole sits 4 mm in from both edges at its corner
Exactly eight holes, nothing else cut out

notes: Board dimensions are the maker's measurements (many 30/38-pin ESP32 dev boards have no mounting holes; this one does). M2.5 clearance 2.7, M3 clearance 3.4 (ISO 273 medium). Edge offsets: board holes (70 − 47)/2 = 11.5 and (40 − 23.5)/2 = 8.25.
